name: Default
shortDescription: Near real-time speech-to-text server on CPU with a WebSocket streaming endpoint and an OpenAI-compatible transcription API, powered by faster-whisper.

alerts.message: There is no web UI and every request needs the generated WHISPERLIVE_API_KEY. OpenAI-compatible clients work with base URL https://<your-domain>/v1 and that key as the API key. WebSocket clients connect to the root URL and must send the key as an "Authorization: Bearer" header or a ?token= query parameter; the upstream Python client and browser extensions do not send it yet.

Transcription runs on the CPU and models are downloaded from Hugging Face on first use, so the first request is slow and larger models need several GB of RAM. WHISPERLIVE_OMP_NUM_THREADS sets how many CPU threads transcription uses.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
